editorial:
Imagine having to lock your own child in a room because she turned into a zombie, but you still can't bring yourself to let her go. That is the heartbreaking spot where you find the main character in this wild ride. He is desperate to save his daughter, and some mysterious people offer him a deal: deliver a secret package through a city full of monsters, and he gets the cure. The vibe is tense and gritty, making you feel the pressure of the clock ticking while he fights off waves of undead creatures just to get back home to his girl.

You will love how the action never really stops, and the acting makes you truly care about the father's struggle. While some of the zombie makeup looks a bit cheap in a few spots, the twists in the plot keep you guessing until the very end. If you are into survival stories, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: At the end, the man delivers the package and finds out it was actually a trap. The package contained a signal device to lure more zombies to the facility. The villains never had a cure; they just needed a brave person to clear the path. In a final twist, the daughter breaks free and kills the bad guys. She is still a zombie, but she remembers her dad and protects him as they walk away together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie movies with a lot of heart.
